title: Nutty Velvety Korean Porcini Kalguksu Noodle Soup
description: A hearty, comforting Korean noodle soup featuring porcini mushrooms and a rich, nutty flavor profile, suitable for meal prep and low-carb diets.

ingredients.name: Porcini mushrooms
ingredients.notes: Fresh or dried, rehydrated according to package instructions

ingredients.name: Kalguksu noodles
ingredients.notes: Korean hand-cut wheat flour noodles, or substitute with soba or rice noodles

ingredients.name: Gochujang
ingredients.notes: Korean chili paste, fermented in soybean paste, rice, and red pepper flakes

ingredients.name: Soy sauce
ingredients.notes: light or dark, choose your flavor profile

instructions: Heat sesame oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Sear porcini mushrooms until fragrant, about 3 minutes.
Add Korean chili flakes, if using, and cook for an additional minute.
Add gochujang, soy sauce, and Korean chili paste, if using, and stir to combine.
Add sliced ginger and minced garlic, and cook until fragrant, about 2 minutes.
Add kalguksu noodles and stir to combine, cooking for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until noodles are tender but still retain some texture.
Season with toasted sesame oil and serve hot, garnished with chopped scallions and toasted sesame seeds.
